description: Final integration pass: update login/register templates for signals, update cart.component.html for removed method, add ConfirmDialogComponent and ToastComponent to admin/user layouts if needed, verify all imports are consistent.
steps: 1. Update src/app/features/auth/login/login.component.html: Change all references from 'loading' to 'loading()' and 'error' to 'error()' since they are now signals. For example: [disabled]='loading' becomes [disabled]='loading()', *ngIf='error' or @if(error) becomes @if(error()), {{error}} becomes {{error()}}.
2. Update src/app/features/auth/register/register.component.html: Same pattern - 'loading' to 'loading()', 'error' to 'error()', 'success' to 'success()'.
3. Update src/app/features/public/cart/cart.component.html: Ensure it uses getItemLineTotal(item) not getLineTotal(item). Search for any getLineTotal references and replace with getItemLineTotal.

4. Add ConfirmDialogComponent to admin-layout and user-layout so admin/user pages can also use confirm dialogs. Update src/app/layout/admin-layout/admin-layout.component.ts to import ConfirmDialogComponent and add <app-confirm-dialog /> to its template. Same for src/app/layout/user-layout/user-layout.component.ts.
5. Add ToastComponent to admin-layout and user-layout templates as well so toast notifications work across all layouts.

6. Verify that the product-detail.component.html is updated to use the new child components (ProductGalleryComponent, ProductCustomizationComponent, DesignUploadComponent, ProductPricingComponent) with correct input/output bindings.
7. Ensure the header.component.html is updated to use <app-search-bar> and <app-mobile-menu> child components with correct bindings.

8. Run a final check: grep for any remaining SafeUrlPipe references in page-header to ensure clean removal. Grep for any remaining LegacyCartItem references. Grep for remaining bare confirm() calls that should have been replaced.
acceptance_criteria: Login template uses loading() and error() signal accessors
Register template uses loading(), error(), success() signal accessors
Cart template uses getItemLineTotal only (no getLineTotal)
ConfirmDialogComponent and ToastComponent are available in admin and user layouts
All cross-file references are consistent after the refactoring
No remaining SafeUrlPipe in page-header imports
No remaining LegacyCartItem/LegacyCartCustomization references in cart.service.ts
verification: Read login.component.html to verify signal accessor syntax
Read register.component.html to verify signal accessor syntax
Read cart.component.html to verify no getLineTotal references
Grep for 'SafeUrlPipe' to ensure no lingering references in page-header
Grep for 'LegacyCartItem' to ensure complete removal
Grep for 'confirm(' in admin components to verify replacement (only closeConfirm should remain in reviews)
